newsitem.title: KENYA: Blue-chip stocks push up Nairobi bourse index.
newsitem.headline: Blue-chip stocks push up Nairobi bourse index.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks built on Thursday's gains to push the Nairobi Stock Exchange 20-share index up by 40.74 points to close at 3379.54, bourse officials said on Friday.
In the absence of trading on the special boards, turnover eased to 16.171 million shillings ($300,000) traded on 302,522 shares, compared to 84.803 million shillings on 1,117,399 shares on Thursday.
This month had seen increased participation by foreign investors probably because prices had dipped once companies closed their books, brokers said.
"The thing we're waiting for now is the interim results in June," a senior broker said.
Barclays Bank gained a shilling to close at 116 while Kenya Commercial Bank closed at 92 from 94. Standard Chartered Bank edged to 46.25 from 45.75.
Brooke Bond was unchanged at 126 while Rea Vipingo Plantations gained 0.20 to close at 8.90.
Foreign investors bought Sasini Tea & Coffee at between 76 and 80 from 76.50, Kenya Airways at 9 from 8.55, and Uchumi Supermarket at between 40.50 and 42, from 40.50.
Nation Printers & Publishers eased to 161 from 163 while Kenya Breweries edged up to 62 from 58. Kenya Power & Lighting gained a shilling to close at 127.
